items.exampleEn: The weather got better in the afternoon.
Do your kids go to bed before midnight?
items.exampleZh: 你的孩子半夜十二點前會上床睡覺嗎？

items.exampleEn: Do you want to go shopping with me?
items.exampleZh: 你想跟我一起去購物嗎？

items.exampleEn: Have a good time, and call me later!
items.exampleZh: 玩得愉快，晚點打電話給我！

items.exampleEn: My brother has a cold, so he is staying home today.
items.exampleZh: 我哥哥感冒了，所以他今天待在家。

items.exampleEn: Our class will have a party after the test.
items.exampleZh: 我們班考完試後會開派對。

items.exampleEn: I finished my homework just in time.

items.sentenceEn: I hope your mother gets better soon.
items.sentenceZh: 希望你媽媽早日好起來。

items.audioEn: We had a good time at the night market last night.
items.audioZh: 我們昨晚在夜市玩得很愉快。
items.questionZh: 說話的人覺得昨晚怎麼樣？
options: It was too crowded to walk
It was a lot of fun
The food there was too expensive

items.sentenceEn: My sister and I went shopping after lunch.
items.sentenceZh: 我姊姊和我午餐後去購物。

items.sentenceEn: Hurry, or we won't get there in time.
items.sentenceZh: 快一點，不然我們會來不及趕到那裡。

items.stemEn: I'm so tired. I think I'll ____ early tonight.
items.stemZh: 我好累，我想我今晚會早點上床睡覺。

items.stemEn: Our teacher ____, so we have a different teacher today.
items.stemZh: 我們老師感冒了，所以今天換別的老師上課。

items.passageEn: Last Friday was Leo's tenth birthday, and his family had a party at home. In the morning, Leo and his mom went shopping for food and balloons. Leo had a cold last week, but he was getting better, so he felt fine. His grandparents arrived in time for the cake. Everyone took photos and had a good time. Leo was so tired that he went to bed at nine.
items.passageZh: 上星期五是 Leo 的十歲生日，他家人在家裡開了派對。早上，Leo 和媽媽去買食物和氣球。Leo 上星期感冒了，不過已經在好轉，所以他覺得還好。他的爺爺奶奶及時趕到，一起吃蛋糕。大家拍了照，玩得很愉快。Leo 累到九點就上床睡覺了。

questions.questionZh: 早上 Leo 和媽媽做了什麼？
Leo 為什麼九點就睡了？

items.promptZh: 我妹妹昨晚十一點才上床睡覺。
referenceEn: My younger sister didn't go to bed until eleven last night.
My sister went to bed at eleven last night.
Last night, my little sister went to bed at eleven.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 went to bed 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 went to sleep、didn't go to sleep until 等）也算對
昨晚的事用過去式（例如 went to bed、didn't go to sleep until 等）
「才」可不譯，或寫例如 didn't … until 等
「妹妹」可寫，例如 younger sister、little sister、sister 等

referenceEn: My English got better this year.
This year, my English got better.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 got better 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 improved、has improved 等）也算對
時態可寫，例如 got better、has gotten better、improved、has improved 等
寫 got much better、got a lot better 等也正確
